metadata.title: Set up your child
metadata.description: A few quick steps: your child’s profile, a companion, and the settings you want.

guide.welcome: Hi! I am Hort. I will show you around.
guide.child: Who are we helping? Just a first name is fine.
guide.interests: What does your child love? I will pick matching examples.
guide.tutor: Every companion helps in their own way. Take your time.
guide.alexa: Alexa is optional. Skip it if you like.
guide.controls: You decide. Everything here can stay private.
guide.done: All set! Time for the first homework.

welcome.title: Let’s set things up together
welcome.description: It takes about three minutes. Everything is saved as you go, so you can stop and come back.

child.title: Add your child
child.description: A first name, the federal state and the grade, so Hort fits the school curriculum.

companion.title: Choose a companion
companion.description: Pick interests and the friend who will help with homework.

controls.title: Set your safety rules
controls.description: Voice, learning times and what Hort may note. You stay in control.

welcome.promise: Hort never gives the solution. Your child still does the thinking.

child.title: Tell us about your child
child.description: Hort uses this to match the school curriculum of your child’s grade.
child.displayName: What should Hort call your child?
child.displayNameHint: A first name or nickname is enough. Please no surname.
child.federalStateHint: The curriculum is different in every state.
child.privacy: Only you can see this profile. Your child does not need an account.

interests.title: What does {name} enjoy?
interests.description: Choose up to {max}. Hort uses them to pick examples your child likes. You can skip this.
interests.limitReached: That is the maximum. Remove one to choose another.

tutor.title: Who should help {name}?
tutor.description: Every companion has their own voice and way of explaining. You can change this later.
tutor.languageNote: Companions speak German with your child, so their words below are in German.
tutor.audioUnavailable: The introduction is not available right now. You can still choose this companion.
tutor.pick: Tap a companion to meet them.

alexa.title: Connect Alexa (optional)
alexa.description: Later, your child can start Hort by voice through Alexa. You can disconnect it at any time.
alexa.unavailableNote: Connecting Alexa is still being built. Nothing is stored here, and the setup works without it.
alexa.linkedNote: Alexa is connected to this account.

steps.link: You connect your Alexa account with Hort once.
steps.say: Your child says the sentence above to start.
steps.help: Hort helps your child think the task through, and never gives the solution.

controls.title: Safety and settings
controls.description: You decide what {name} may do. The safest choice is already selected.

voice.title: Talking to {tutor}
voice.description: {name} may speak to {tutor} and hear the answer. Typing always works. Alexa cannot be connected yet.

time.title: Learning time
time.description: Keep homework help to times that suit your family.
time.windowDescription: Hort is only available inside this window.
time.note: Times apply from the first homework help. The daily limit is saved now and applied once Hort can measure learning time.
time.limitHint: How long Hort helps per day.

insights.title: Notes for your summary
insights.description: Hort may note which kinds of tasks {name} needed help with, for your summary in the parent area. No chats are kept.

items.solution: Hort never gives the solution to a task. Your child does the thinking.
items.checks: Text for your child goes through safety checks first.
items.private: Only you can see this profile. Your child has no account.

guardian.label: I am the parent or legal guardian of {name}, and I allow Hort to store the details from this setup.
guardian.hint: Required to continue. Privacy notice version {version}.

review.title: Is everything right?
review.description: Have a last look. You can change anything now.

done.title: {name} is ready!
done.description: Whenever there is homework, {tutor} will think it through together with {name}.

reset.label: Reset setup (dev only)
reset.hint: Development only: deletes your child profiles so you can run the setup again.

errors.notFound: We could not find this profile. Please go back one step and try again.
errors.alreadyOnboarded: Your child is already set up. Taking you to your home.
errors.setupIncomplete: A step is still missing. Please go through the steps once more.
errors.welcomeAlreadyCompleted: The welcome is already done. Taking you to the home page.
errors.devResetUnavailable: This is only available while developing.
errors.infrastructure: We could not save that right now. Nothing was changed. Please try again in a moment.
errors.unexpected: We could not confirm that this was saved. Please try again.
errors.voiceNoticeOutdated: The speech recognition notice has changed. Please read it again, then switch it on.

validation.displayNameRequired: Please enter a name for your child.
validation.displayNameTooLong: The name can have at most {displayNameMax} characters.
validation.displayNameInvalid: Please use letters, numbers or simple punctuation only.
validation.interestsInvalid: One of the interests is not available.
validation.dailyLimitInvalid: Please choose one of the listed limits.
validation.windowInvalid: The window must end at least 30 minutes after it starts.
validation.guardianConfirmationRequired: Please confirm that you are the parent or guardian.

childWelcome.saveError: That didn’t save. Please try again.

voice.title: Listen!
voice.unavailable: No sound right now. Carry on!
voice.failed: That did not play. Try again?

voiceConsent.title: {name} may speak instead of typing
voiceConsent.notice: When {name} speaks, Hort sends the recording once to the service ElevenLabs, which turns it into text. Hort does not keep the recording; {name} sees the text and can correct it. You can switch this off here at any time. Typing always works.
voiceConsent.version: Speech recognition notice, version {version}. Switching it on confirms it.

dashboard.title: A little closer to their learning
dashboard.intro: A calm overview of {name}’s tasks, learning and settings.
dashboard.freshness: This is a snapshot. Refresh to see changes made since it loaded.
dashboard.restricted: Parent access is temporary. You may need to confirm your password again when saving or opening another section.
dashboard.overviewDescription: Recorded activity, with room for the things numbers cannot tell us.
dashboard.tasksDescription: Tasks started in this period, grouped by their current stored status.
dashboard.missingPaused: A separate paused or waiting status is not recorded yet.
dashboard.emptyTitle: Their learning story has room to grow
dashboard.emptyDescription: No saved tasks were started in this period. Tasks will appear here once the learning flow saves them.
dashboard.noCompleted: No finished tasks in this period. Finishing a task is only one part of learning.
dashboard.partial: Showing a bounded selection of up to 100 recent records. Counts describe this selection, not the complete period.
dashboard.evidencePartial: Some evidence could not be counted completely. No incomplete counts are presented as exact.
dashboard.subjectsDescription: Tasks per subject, as recorded when each task started. A count measures activity, not ability.
dashboard.learningDescription: Explore recorded tasks and support, without grades or comparisons with other children.
dashboard.outcomesDescription: Tasks grouped by their start date and current status. This is not a history of status changes.
dashboard.hintDescription: Recorded hints per task. Asking for help is part of learning, not a grade.
dashboard.hintScope: {hints, number} hints across {tasks, plural, one {# task with a known count} other {# tasks with known counts}}; {supported, number} used at least one hint.
dashboard.hintUnavailable: Hint counts are unavailable for this task.
dashboard.insightsOff: Help-related notes are switched off. Hint, answer and comprehension evidence is hidden. You can change this in Settings.
dashboard.evidenceTitle: What does the evidence tell us?
dashboard.answered: {count, plural, one {In # task, your child explained it in their own words} other {In # tasks, your child explained it in their own words}}.
dashboard.evidenceCaution: After a task, HortAi asks your child to explain it in their own words. Any real reply counts; it is not checked for correctness, so it shows taking part, not understanding or mastery.
dashboard.comprehensionCount: Explained in their own words: {answered, number} of {asked, number} questions
dashboard.comprehensionUnavailable: No own-words explanations are available for this task.
dashboard.topicsDescription: The competency from the official curriculum this task was matched to when it started, in the curriculum’s own (German) wording. It names what the task was about, not what your child has mastered.
dashboard.topicsUnavailable: This task was not matched to a curriculum topic.
dashboard.practiceUnavailable: There is no reviewed recommendation system yet. We won’t infer practice needs from a few hints or finished tasks.
dashboard.homeUnavailable: Reviewed, task-specific suggestions are not available yet.
dashboard.trendsUnavailable: A useful trend needs reliable history and an agreed comparison method. No trend or ability score is inferred here.
dashboard.allTasks: See all {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} in Learning
dashboard.detailPrivacy: Original task text, answers, hint wording, photos, audio and conversations are not included in this parent view.
dashboard.classDescription: Join your child’s class with the teacher’s invite code, so teacher assignments appear here and in your child’s tasks.
dashboard.assignmentsDescription: Assignments from the child’s current active class. Their progress uses all recorded sessions, independent of the learning-period filter.
dashboard.assignmentsEmpty: No assignments are available from the current active class. This does not establish whether a teacher has set other homework.
dashboard.assignmentActions: Submitting or changing teacher assignments is not available here.
dashboard.timeTitle: Time for learning, time for other things
dashboard.timeDescription: Measured help time today, your saved limits, and what they mean for your child right now.
dashboard.timeUnavailable: Today’s learning time could not be loaded
dashboard.timeUnavailableDescription: The measurement could not be read just now. Nothing is shown instead of a guess; refresh to try again.
dashboard.timeEnforcement: When the limit is reached or the time window is closed, HortAi starts no new help and gives no further hints, and your child sees a calm explanation. The limit counts help sessions in HortAi only.
dashboard.settingsDescription: Changes apply only after HortAi confirms that they were saved.
dashboard.saveError: Settings were not saved. Your previous settings still apply. Try again, or reopen the parent area if access expired.
dashboard.fixedChoices: The companion and interests belong to the child’s welcome choices and cannot be changed here.
dashboard.voiceEffect: With voice off, your child can type instead of sending recordings for transcription.
dashboard.insightsEffect: This switch controls help-related notes in the parent view. Turning it off does not delete stored records or stop all learning-state storage.
dashboard.privacyTitle: A clear view of their data
dashboard.privacyDescription: What the application currently does, and what still needs a defined policy.
dashboard.profileDataDescription: HortAi stores a display name, state, grade, selected interests and companion, parent controls, consent confirmations and progression records. The learning schema can store task text, hints, answers and comprehension replies. This dashboard receives only selected metadata and counts.
dashboard.photosDescription: Worksheet-photo recognition is outside the current product scope. This dashboard has no worksheet-photo storage or deletion operation.
dashboard.voicePrivacyDescription: For speech-to-text, recordings are held in memory for the request and sent to ElevenLabs after guardian consent. HortAi does not save the original recording. The returned text may become task text when submitted. Provider retention is not established by an application deletion promise.
dashboard.retentionDescription: A retention period and automated cleanup for child profiles and learning records have not been defined. No automatic deletion schedule is promised. Security audit retention is separate; its cleanup scheduler is not currently connected.
dashboard.deletionDescription: Production deletion and export are not implemented. There is no delete action available here. A complete process must cover learning records, derived data, backups and any provider obligations.
dashboard.safetyDescription: No safety notes or sensitive disclosures are shown. A parent role does not grant access to every private conversation. Disclosure requires a reviewed safeguarding policy, which is not implemented for this view.
dashboard.worldDescription: The same starting island as in the child’s World. Individual discoveries are not recorded yet.
dashboard.gateDescription: Confirm your account password to see your child’s overview and manage their settings.
dashboard.gateUnavailable: Parent access requires active account authentication. It is unavailable while authentication is disabled.
dashboard.errorTitle: The overview could not be loaded
dashboard.errorDescription: No missing records have been replaced with estimates. Refresh to try again; you may need to confirm parent access again.
dashboard.workedWithHints: {count, plural, =0 {Worked without hints} one {Worked with # hint} other {Worked with # hints}}
dashboard.helpDescription: Tasks per kind of hint, from understanding the task to a similar example. A task counts once for each kind of hint it used.
dashboard.helpScope: {tasks, plural, one {# task has} other {# tasks have}} a known hint count; {unaided, number} of them needed no hint.
dashboard.helpEmpty: No hint evidence is recorded for the tasks in this period.
dashboard.helpTaskDescription: Hints follow a ladder from understanding the task to a similar example. The marked steps were used in this task.
dashboard.ownAnswersDescription: HortAi checks the answer your child gives and never reveals the solution. A check describes one answer, not ability.
dashboard.ownAnswers: Your child gave their own answer in {own, number} of {tasks, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}; in {correct, number}, an answer was checked as correct.
dashboard.answersGiven: {count, plural, =0 {No own answer recorded yet} one {# own answer} other {# own answers}}
dashboard.taskFromAssignment: A teacher assignment in {subject}. The task text itself stays private.
dashboard.taskFromChild: A task your child brought in, in {subject}. The task text itself stays private.
dashboard.topicsExploredDescription: Curriculum sections the tasks were matched to, grouped by subject. A count shows how often a topic came up, not how well it went.
dashboard.topicsExploredEmpty: No task in this period was matched to a curriculum topic.
dashboard.topicsUnclassified: {count, plural, one {# of {total, number} tasks was} other {# of {total, number} tasks were}} not matched to a curriculum topic.
dashboard.timeOfLimit: {used, number} of {limit, number} minutes used today
dashboard.timeLeft: {minutes, plural, =0 {No minutes left} one {# minute left} other {# minutes left}} of {limit, number} today
dashboard.timeMeasurement: Counted from your child’s steps in help sessions today (Berlin time): the time between steps, with any pause counted as at most 5 minutes. Thinking or working away from HortAi is not included. This is the same number the daily limit uses.

timeStatus.open: Open: your child can get help now.
timeStatus.low: Almost at the daily limit or the end of the time window.
timeStatus.closed_limit_reached: Daily limit reached: no new help today. It opens again tomorrow.
timeStatus.closed_outside_window: Outside the allowed time window: help opens again at {time}.

dashboard.timeHistoryUnavailable: Only today is shown. A day-by-day history of help time is not available yet.
